title: Heisig primitive and radical-family catalogue
scope: A deduplicated union of explicit RTK1/RTK3 mnemonic roles, supplemental shapes, directly reviewed ordinary teaching units and all 214 traditional radical families. This is not an author-certified minimal alphabet or an enumeration of every recursively reusable whole kanji.
ordering: Approximate modern RTK1 sixth-edition / RTK3 sequence. Exact old-edition label references remain in evidence. Modern shape-use anchors are not formal introduction claims. Unattested traditional families have null order.
meaning_policy: Heisig mnemonic labels, numbered character keywords and RTH keywords are separate fields; none is automatically an etymology. Null means unverified, not absent from all possible sources.

rtk1.title: Remembering the Kanji 1, 5th edition (2007)
rtk1.scope: Author text, standalone starred primitives, and numbered teaching units; no stories reproduced.

rtk3.title: Remembering the Kanji 3, 2nd edition (2008)
rtk3.label_status: Verified in authored book text; special glyphs visually verified from rendered PDF. Old edition numbers, modern full-character anchors crosswalked through sdcr CSV. Not all modern introduction positions verified in current book.

glyphs.scope: 234 supplemental drawing variants, grouped into 216 source labels. CC0 claim applies to author contributions; not a blanket licence to Heisig books.

rtk_order.scope: Edition crosswalk, corrected against cyphar for modern RTK1 numbers/keywords.

rth_characters.title: RTH character keyword crosswalk (not a primitive index)
rth_characters.source_scope: Community transcription of 3035 RTH character frames and seven extra c-labeled rows. Excludes non-character primitives. Full character keyword is not interchangeable with component mnemonic meaning. Volume inferred at frame 1500.
rth_characters.numbering_caveat: Source numbering is not fully verified. Three mismatches were observed in RTH1 frames21-24 against book text; these are recorded in verified_number_corrections, not silently rewritten.

rth1.scope: Targeted checks of author text in third-party OCR, with glyph context checked.

rth2.scope: Targeted author-text checks of silver and valentine; not all primitive meanings independently checked.

cover_radical_gloss.scope: MOE primary dictionary verification of 襾 cover, distinguished from the Unicode technical radical name WEST.
